about_the_game: Immerse yourself in Cottonville—where you can plant, harvest, and craft stunning outfits in a cozy town. You can play up to level 15 in this demo to get a taste of the core experience. If you enjoy your time here, please leave a rating and share your feedback to help us improve. Grow your style, and let your creativity flourish!
